context: A 9-panel animation gallery demonstrating D3.js morphing transitions between chart types: Circle↔Rectangle, Bar↔Pie, Star↔Circle, Line↔Area, Scatter↔Bar, Horizontal↔Vertical bars, Grouped↔Stacked, Treemap↔Circle Pack, Donut↔Sunburst — all with synthetic random data.
first_impression: A technically accomplished animation showcase that treats encoding correctness as a secondary concern to smooth morphing, but mostly avoids major honesty violations.
what_works: Bar/area zero-baselines are consistently respected (demos 4–7 all anchor y0 at zero); scale domains use d3.max/d3.extent from data rather than arbitrary magic numbers; d3.pack() handles circle-area scaling correctly in the treemap↔pack demo.
what_doesnt: Demos 5 and 6 hardcode y-domains to [0,1] matching synthetic generation range — would silently clip or distort real data outside that range (scaling relation failure); no key functions on most .data() joins, so a data-update scenario would corrupt animations via element reuse mismatch.
